Productivity and activity details. See exactly how each person spends the working day.
Open Productivity, and choose the Breakdown tab. Pick Individual View or Team View, and a range.
View by graph shows productive, unproductive, neutral and idle time, as stacked bars, day by day. Hover a bar for the exact hours.
Switch to View by list. Each row shows the productive time, and a bar with the share of each category. Click Details to open one day.
The details window lists the productive, unproductive and neutral applications and websites, with the time spent in each.
The Idle tab shows when an application stayed open, with no keyboard or mouse input.
The Keyboard and Mouse tab counts key presses and mouse actions in every ten minutes. It never records what is typed. Use the Date box to look at another day.
On a person's productivity page, Applications and websites shows which rule decided each category. Click View more, to see the window titles, when window title capture is on.
Use Export to download the breakdown as a CSV file.
Done. Next, check attendance against the required hours.
